% Minimal pandoc LaTeX template for the MissLearn user guide.
%
% Pandoc's own default template calls \IfDocumentMetadataTF, which arrived in
% the LaTeX kernel in 2022; the MiKTeX 21.12 installed here is older, so the
% stock template fails before it reaches the document. This template asks for
% nothing newer than that kernel provides, which keeps the PDF buildable on
% the machine that has to build it rather than requiring a TeX upgrade.
%
% Build:
%   pandoc docs/USER_GUIDE.md -o docs/MissLearn_User_Guide.pdf \
%          --pdf-engine=xelatex --template=docs/_static/guide_template.tex \
%          --toc --toc-depth=2 --no-highlight
\documentclass[11pt,a4paper]{article}

\usepackage{fontspec}
\setmainfont{Segoe UI}
\setmonofont{Consolas}[Scale=0.85]

\usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}
\usepackage{longtable}
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{array}
\usepackage{calc}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{fancyvrb}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage[normalem]{ulem}
\usepackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{amssymb}
\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}

% Segoe UI carries every non-ASCII character the guide uses except one, so
% that one is routed to its maths equivalent rather than silently dropping
% out of the PDF. The others (superscript two and three, middle dot) render
% from the text font directly.
\usepackage{newunicodechar}
\newunicodechar{≲}{\ensuremath{\lesssim}}

% Pandoc emits these; they are not defined by the classes above.
\providecommand{\tightlist}{%
  \setlength{\itemsep}{0pt}\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}}
\providecommand{\passthrough}[1]{#1}
\providecommand{\pandocbounded}[1]{#1}

% Verbatim blocks: small enough that the widest thing the guide prints, the
% 74-column summary() report, fits inside the margin. breaklines is not used
% because it belongs to fvextra, which this TeX installation does not carry.
\DefineVerbatimEnvironment{verbatim}{Verbatim}{%
  fontsize=\small,samepage=false,xleftmargin=0pt}

\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\setlength{\parskip}{0.6em}
\setcounter{tocdepth}{$if(toc-depth)$$toc-depth$$else$2$endif$}
\setcounter{secnumdepth}{-2}

$if(title)$
\title{$title$}
$endif$
$if(author)$
\author{$for(author)$$author$$sep$ \and $endfor$}
$endif$
$if(date)$
\date{$date$}
$endif$

\begin{document}

$if(title)$
\maketitle
$endif$

$if(toc)$
{\hypersetup{linkcolor=black}\tableofcontents}
\newpage
$endif$

$body$

\end{document}
